body.x: Bokuk Electronics will introduce Ai-DeepSleep products in small size in the form of cushions at CES.
It shows the various applications of Ai-DeepSleep. Visitors will have a new experience because they can measure real-time biometric data and current stress levels just by sitting down.
Bokuk Electronics is introducing two new directions at CES.
First, it provides an optimal sleep environment through combination with peripherals such as electric blanket.
Second, it provides a care system through organic connection with nursing homes, welfare workers, and families through immediate alarm services.
Ai-DeepSleep is a comprehensive platform that can measure the quality of sleep and health status based on the user's biometric signals.
It uses a flat foldable mat and air cell micro sensor.
It measures real-time bio-signals such as heart rate, respiratory rate, and movement.
Users can receive multiple sleep analysis data the day after using Ai-DeepSleep.
The sleep analysis data includes sleep time, sleep stage, snoring, and the number of apnea.
The analyzed data is managed by the server and provides statistical data to the user.
When a user experiences a sudden abnormality such as hyperventilation,
It provides notifications through APP so that users can get help through their connected guardians and facilities.

When Bokuk Electronics' electric blanket and Ai-DeepSleep are used together, the user will be able to receive customized temperature control according to the sleep state. Starting with the combination with electric blanket, it will grow into a comprehensive platform that can provide an optimal sleep environment.
